descriptionChirho: The proper noun Mosheh (Moses), the great lawgiver and prophet who led Israel out of Egypt. All four clusters refer to the same individual with variation only in prepositional framing and conjunction: bare name (S114527, 760x), with preposition 'against/in' (S114531, S114533), 'through' (S114534), and with conjunction 'and' (S114520 via S114531). Multilingual evidence is perfectly uniform: eng 'Moses', spa 'Moises/Mosheh', hin 'Musa' (मूसा), arb 'Musa' (مُوسَى), kor 'Mose' (모세), swa 'Musa'. There is no semantic distinction between these uses; they are all references to the same biblical figure with different syntactic roles.
